properties.name: notion.token
properties.description: Notion integration token used for API requests.

properties.name: notion.database-id
properties.description: Notion data source or database id to query.

properties.name: notion.page-size
properties.description: Maximum number of Notion records to fetch per request.

properties.name: notion.connect-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Connection timeout in seconds for Notion HTTPS calls.

properties.name: notion.ssl.trust-store
properties.description: Absolute path to a JKS or PKCS12 truststore used for Notion HTTPS calls.

properties.name: notion.ssl.trust-store-type
properties.description: Type of the Notion truststore, such as PKCS12 or JKS.

properties.name: notion.ssl.insecure-skip-verification
properties.description: Temporarily disables TLS certificate validation for Notion HTTPS calls. Unsafe for production.
